## Verdict: PASS. The failing line is fixed, and there is no new blocker

## (1) The failing line, re-run

The line was N-52 (4): "makeBlock's deep-spine branch keeps a slit lane while recording the block court".

| part of the required change | status | evidence |
|---|---|---|
| Reproduce (a deep block with a reservation hole) | **reproduced on the pre-fix code**, CONFIRMED | The seat's own probe (`close-s2/probes/zz-close-s2.test.ts`, run in the mirror with the pre-fix file) covers 450 holed one-district lands. It reported `"deepSlitInserted": 18, "violB": 18, "violC": 18`. Its examples include `B rect 10000x4200 hole-left p0.3 s1: deep lane way:f5aq4mcksb8zs bridges one face` (the deep lane's two half-edges bound the same L1 face, so the lane is a slit) and `C rect 10000x4200 hole-left p0.3 s1: block court faces -1` (the court block's recorded seed lies on the kept slit lane, not in a face). |
| Detect-and-refuse; ways and block interiors agree | **fixed**, CONFIRMED | The same probe with the fixed file reported `"runs": 450, "deepRungs": 98, "deepCut": 66, "deepRefusedSlit": 18, "deepRefusedOther": 14, "deepSlitInserted": 0, "violA": 0, "violB": 0, "violC": 0, "threw": 0, "refusedStage": 0`. The same 18 cases are now refused before the kernel (why `'slit'`), and nothing stays in the arena. On the pre-fix code, each of those cases pushed two deep rungs, an inserted `slit` and a `refused` with why `''`. That accounts for the totals: 116 = 98 + 18. |
| The remedy differs from N-52's wording (`takeOut` after the slit) | **accepted**, PLAUSIBLE (by reading) | C-0288 (2) refuses the slit judgement before `connectHole` instead of inserting the slit and then removing it. The end state is the same (no lane, no junction row, no width, no minted id, and the block is a court with the pre-slit kerb), and no kernel call is spent. N-52 (4) asks for "detect-and-refuse"; this is the cheaper form of it. A choices row records the call. |
| A pin: a deep block with a reservation hole, asserting ways ⇔ block interior consistency | **present and green**, CONFIRMED | `packages/layout/test/infill/fabric/holes.test.ts` has the fixture "the 120 × 45 m land with a 6 × 10 m hole at seed 1" and the 32-case property "ways agree with the blocks". Both are green in near (below). Both are red on the pre-fix file (mutant K01 below: `AssertionError: expected [ { …(4) }, { …(5) } ] to deeply equal [ Array(1) ]` and `expected 1 to be +0`). |
| A choices row | **present**, CONFIRMED | `choices.md` row C-0288 (refines C-0237 (8) and N-52 (4)'s remedy). It states the reproduction, the remedy, the pins, the mutants, and the one-time output shift: 39 of 600 holed districts differ at seed 1, and M0-b-04's bench bars all hold. |

### Kill-test of the fix (13 targeted mutants, mirror m1, `--maxWorkers=1`)

Each mutant ran first against `holes.test.ts` and `deep.test.ts`. A mutant that survived that run then ran against the
whole near set (12 files). Logs: `close-s2/logs/mutants.txt` and `mut-*.txt`.

| id | mutant | result |
|---|---|---|
| K01 | the pre-fix file: the slit lane is kept, and the block is recorded court | KILLED (holes.test.ts, 2 tests) |
| K02 | `makeBlock` passes `slitAllowed` `true`: the slit lane is kept | KILLED (2 tests) |
| K03 | the slit is inserted and then taken out (`takeOut`), and the block is recorded with the child's seed as cut (`back_lane`) although the lane is gone | KILLED (2 tests: `expected { id: 'block:242h2km49qfs4', …(7) } to match object { depthClass: 'deep', …(1) }`, `expected +0 to be 1`) |
| K04 | the refusal is moved after `connectHole` without `takeOut`: the lane's edges stay, and there is no Way record | KILLED (2 tests: `expected [ 'way:ring', 'way:f5aq4mcksb8zs' ] to deeply equal [ 'way:ring' ]`) |
| K05 | the block is not marked court on a 'slit' refusal | KILLED (2 tests) |
| K06 | no `W_DEEP_SPINE_REFUSED` warning on a 'slit' refusal | KILLED (1 test: `expected {} to deeply equal { W_DEEP_SPINE_REFUSED: 1 }`) |
| K07 | no 'deep' rung recorded on a 'slit' refusal | KILLED (2 tests) |
| K08 | every slit is refused (`slitAllowed` defaults to false) | KILLED (3 tests, including the ladder's hole slit) |
| K09 | the guard is inverted (`j.kind !== 'slit'`) | KILLED (5 tests) |
| K10 | `makeBlock` tests `if (t.ok)` instead of `if (t.ok && !t.slit)` | survived near (75/75). **Equivalent**: with `slitAllowed` false, `tryCandidate` returns before the slit branch, so `t.slit` is never true here. Note N-20. |
| K11 | the seeds are cleared on a 'slit' refusal | KILLED (1 test: `expected +0 to be 1`) |
| K12 | the refusal is marked `touched: true` | survived near (75/75). **Equivalent**: `makeBlock` never reads `touched`; only the ladder does (~line 1077). Note N-20. |
| K13 | the refusal's why is `''` instead of `'slit'` | KILLED (2 tests) |

That is 11 killed and 2 equivalent, with no non-equivalent survivor, CONFIRMED. The equivalence of K10 and K12 is
PLAUSIBLE (by reading).
